flags.headword: nam nữ thụ thụ bất thân
flags.why: The rule does not make a general exception for relatives, as illustrated by its traditional application to a man and his sister-in-law ([discussion](https://www.trithucmoi.org/tranh-luan-nay-lu-nam-nu-thu-thu-bat-than-chu-nen-lam-gi-neu-chi-dau-bi-duoi-nuoc/)).
flags.fix: men and women should avoid direct physical contact (a traditional rule of propriety)
